note: gustav-klimt.md FAQ#11 states directly: 'Klimt was a founding member of the Vienna Secession, the Austrian branch of the broader Art Nouveau movement... his decorative use of gold leaf and pattern is sometimes cited as an influence on the later style [Art Deco].' The body also confirms the gold-leaf/metal-leaf technique worked into figures ('gold leaf, silver leaf and platinum leaf in the two figures, worked into resin oil colours') and that Klimt's gold pictures date to the years after his Dec 1903 Ravenna trip through his 1918 death, i.e. before WWI (1914), matching the bridge sentence's 'finished in the years before the first world war.'
